function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you’re in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone (New York City), the local time is usually 4 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC‑4) during daylight‑saving time (which is in effect on May 13, 2026).  

To get the precise time, just check the clock on your phone, computer, or any reliable world‑time website.
